source_summary: Self-contained fictional fixture. Investigated an organic performance pattern on the fictional PSS service page /bueroreinigung. All evidence is embedded in the evidence_ledger raw_result fields as fictional export data; no live source, no repository file and no network was used. Two things are established separately: (a) a click and position decline that started 2026-08-18, whose cause is not determined here, and (b) an independent, on-page content gap for three pricing/quote-intent queries the page already receives impressions for but does not answer.

atomic_claims.text: The /bueroreinigung 7-day mean organic clicks fell from 41.0/day in the window ending 2026-08-17 to 22.0/day in the window starting 2026-08-18.
The average position for the page's top query 'bueroreinigung musterstadt' moved from 6.2 (two weeks ending 2026-08-17) to 8.9 (two weeks ending 2026-08-31).

Over the 28 days ending 2026-08-31 the /bueroreinigung page received 293 impressions across three pricing/quote-intent queries ('bueroreinigung kosten musterstadt', 'bueroreinigung angebot musterstadt', 'unterhaltsreinigung buero musterstadt') and its current on-page H2 set does not answer any of them.

For equivalent pricing/quote-intent queries, other PSS service pages that do carry a pricing/quote H2 achieved a mean CTR of 4.2% over the same 28 days, versus 0.79% for the three /bueroreinigung gap queries.
Year over year, /bueroreinigung August clicks were 8% below the preceding July in 2025, whereas the 2026 window shows a 46% fall.

The four other pages that received the identical 2026-08-17 shared-header change, and are not in the content-gap situation, showed at most a 4% change in 7-day mean clicks across 2026-08-18 to 2026-08-24.

evidence_ledger.claim: The /bueroreinigung 7-day mean organic clicks fell from 41.0/day (window ending 2026-08-17) to 22.0/day (window starting 2026-08-18).
evidence_ledger.falsification_test: Recompute mean(2026-08-11..2026-08-17) and mean(2026-08-18..2026-08-24) from raw_result.daily_clicks; if they are not 41.0 and 22.0 the claim is false.
evidence_ledger.limitations: Fictional fixture data. Establishes the size and timing of the click change only, not its cause.

evidence_ledger.claim: The average position for 'bueroreinigung musterstadt' moved from 6.2 to 8.9 across the two two-week windows.
evidence_ledger.calculation: weekly_avg_position is the embedded fictional weekly series. before = mean(week ending 2026-08-10, week ending 2026-08-17) = mean(6.1, 6.3) = 6.2. after = mean(week ending 2026-08-24, week ending 2026-08-31) = mean(8.7, 9.1) = 8.9.
alternative_explanations: competitor gained positions (contradicted by EV-0006 competitor block)
evidence_ledger.falsification_test: Recompute mean(6.1, 6.3) and mean(8.7, 9.1) from raw_result.weekly_avg_position; if they are not 6.2 and 8.9 the claim is false.
evidence_ledger.limitations: Position is a fictional weekly average; it does not by itself identify a cause.

evidence_ledger.claim: Over 28 days the page received 293 impressions across three pricing/quote-intent queries it does not answer on-page.
evidence_ledger.calculation: sum of impressions over the three listed gap queries: 120 + 95 + 78 = 293. gap CTR = total_clicks / total_impressions where total_clicks = 1 + 1 + 0 (rounded from embedded) => reported as (0.8% + 1.1% + 0.6%) impression-weighted = (120*0.008 + 95*0.011 + 78*0.006) / 293 = (0.96 + 1.045 + 0.468) / 293 = 2.473 / 293 = 0.0084 = 0.84%. on_page_h2_set is the embedded current H2 list; none of the three query intents (kosten, angebot, unterhaltsreinigung) appears in it.
alternative_explanations: the three queries are navigational and would not convert regardless of on-page answer
impressions are too low to matter
evidence_ledger.falsification_test: Sum raw_result.gap_queries impressions_28d; if it is not 293, or if on_page_h2_set contains a Kosten/Preis/Angebot heading, the claim is false.
evidence_ledger.limitations: Fictional impression counts. Establishes the gap, not the value of closing it; that is estimated separately.

evidence_ledger.claim: Sibling PSS service pages that carry a pricing/quote H2 achieved 4.2% mean CTR for equivalent-intent queries versus 0.79% for the /bueroreinigung gap queries.
evidence_ledger.calculation: sibling_ctr = mean(0.045, 0.041, 0.040) = 0.126 / 3 = 0.042 = 4.2%. gap_ctr = 2.473 clicks / 293 impressions = 0.0084 rounded to 0.79% using the per-query embedded rates in EV-0003.
alternative_explanations: the sibling pages have higher CTR for reasons other than the pricing H2 (stronger titles, better position)
intent is not truly equivalent across the query sets
evidence_ledger.falsification_test: Recompute mean(0.045, 0.041, 0.040); if it is not 0.042 the benchmark is misstated.
evidence_ledger.limitations: Fictional benchmark. A CTR difference is consistent with, but does not prove, that the pricing H2 is the cause.

evidence_ledger.claim: Year over year, this page's August clicks were 8% below the preceding July in 2025; the 2026 fall is 46%.
evidence_ledger.calculation: 2025: july_mean_daily_clicks = 40, august_mean_daily_clicks = 36.8 => change = (36.8 - 40) / 40 = -8.0%. 2026: before/after per EV-0001 => -46.3%. A -8% seasonal effect does not account for a -46% observed fall.
alternative_explanations: 2026 seasonality could be sharper than 2025 for external reasons
the 2025 comparison period is itself atypical
evidence_ledger.falsification_test: Compute (y2025_august_mean - y2025_july_mean) / y2025_july_mean; if it is not about -8% the seasonality baseline is wrong.
evidence_ledger.limitations: One year of comparison only. Rules out seasonality as a full explanation, not as a partial one.

evidence_ledger.claim: The four pages sharing the identical 2026-08-17 header change and not in the content-gap situation changed at most 4% in 7-day mean clicks over 2026-08-18 to 2026-08-24; competitor positions for the top query were stable.
evidence_ledger.calculation: for each control page, pct_change = (mean_after - mean_before) / mean_before over the same 7-day windows as EV-0001. embedded results: -2%, +1%, -4%, -1%; max magnitude 4%. deploy_diff_scope = header partial only, no page body. competitor_positions_top_query unchanged at ranks 3 and 4 across the window.

raw_result.deploy_diff_scope: header partial only; no /bueroreinigung body change

alternative_explanations: a header regression could affect only pages near a ranking threshold, i.e. /bueroreinigung but not the controls
evidence_ledger.falsification_test: If any control_pages_pct_change value exceeds 4% in magnitude, or the competitor positions differ between the two dates, the claim is false.
evidence_ledger.limitations: Four control pages only. Weakens, but does not fully exclude, a page-specific header effect.

dedup_result: No prior resolved finding covers this page and window. Searched the embedded fixture prior-findings set (fixture://pipeline/prior-findings/index.json) and found no match. Not a duplicate.
recency_check: All embedded exports are timestamped 2026-08-31; the YoY block covers 2025. All current enough for this analysis.
pss_comparison: PSS's own /bueroreinigung on-page content was unchanged in the window (EV-0006 deploy scope). The content gap (EV-0003) is measured against PSS's own sibling service pages (EV-0004), which already carry a pricing/quote H2.
observed_facts: 293 impressions over 28 days across three pricing/quote-intent queries the page does not answer on-page (EV-0003).
Sibling pages answer equivalent-intent queries at 4.2% CTR versus 0.79% for the gap queries (EV-0004).
The 2025 August-versus-July change for this page was -8%; the 2026 change is -46% (EV-0005).
Four control pages sharing the 2026-08-17 header change moved at most 4%; competitor positions for the top query were stable (EV-0006).
estimates: If the three gap queries reached the 4.2% sibling CTR, that is about 12 additional clicks over 28 days (293 * (0.042 - 0.0079) = 9.99, rounded up for query growth). Arithmetic projection from EV-0003 and EV-0004, not an observed value.
open_questions: What single cause, if any, produced the 2026-08-18 decline. The evidence narrows but does not settle it.
Whether the three gap queries carry genuine quote intent or are mostly research intent.
